name: Agentkit
tagline: Build AI website chatbots trained on your business content.
description: Agentkit helps businesses create AI chatbots trained on website pages, documents and FAQs. Teams add their source content, customize the chatbot’s branding and embed it on a website. Visitors can ask product or support questions, while lead capture and conversation logs help teams follow up on enquiries. Agentkit supports multiple AI models and multilingual conversations. Its permanent free plan includes 50 message credits per month, one chatbot, 400 KB of training data, 10 links and one seat. No credit card is required to start; paid plans provide larger usage allowances.
